method: Live rules and hard AI; seeded faction-pure 10-slot drafts, with and without a starting boss, mirrored seats, classic 1v1. Economy and recruitment enabled; cards and ultimates disabled. Baseline sample sizes differ by matchup; paired ablation uses identical configurations only.
limitations: AI results do not establish human competitive balance.
Small samples for four factions; repeated seeds and mirrored games are correlated.
Boss composition and map can materially change outcomes.
Economy may recruit additional units during a match.
